post.caption: A silver football takes four months to make. Tiffany & Co. designed the Vince Lombardi Trophy for the very first Super Bowl, in 1967, after NFL commissioner Pete Rozelle asked for Tiffany and only Tiffany. Its Swiss design chief, Oscar Riedener, knew little about football, and the story goes that he sketched it on a napkin. A regulation size football in sterling silver, it weighs about seven pounds and takes about four months and 72 hours of hand work. In 1970 it was renamed for Packers coach Vince Lombardi. A new trophy is made every year, and the winner keeps it.
